method: sRGB relative luminance from browser computed RGB; composite each solid/background-gradient endpoint through transparent ancestor backgrounds. Opaque grayscale two-stop gradients make endpoint bounds conservative over their interior. Unsupported group opacity/filter/blend is flagged rather than treated as qualified. Not screenshot antialiasing or every-state WCAG certification.
